title: Solve calibration equations
scope: Unique bounded 2×2 systems; no general solver claim

items.prompt: Solve x + 2y = 8, 3x − y = 3. Both measurements use the same x,y. Return x and y.
items.solution: Add the second equation to three times the first: 7y=21. Then x=2. Substitution checks both equations.

items.prompt: Two signed actuator commands x,y produce wrench components x+y=3 and 2x−y=-6. This is an unconstrained algebraic allocation, not an actuator-limit claim. Find x,y. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: Subtract the second equation from twice the first: 3y=2b1−b2. Substitute to get x. Check both wrench components.
